sections.title: Form and origin
sections.text: Mammillaria bocasana is a small clumping cactus from north-eastern Mexico. Its spherical stems reach about 5 cm tall and form clusters.

sections.title: Spines and flowering
sections.text: The stems are covered in fine, woolly spines, with hooked reddish-brown central spines. The small flowers are cream to whitish, sometimes tinted yellow or red; the fruits are red.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use was found for this species.
